subject.title: fix(agents): xAI/Grok requests fail after a stale reasoning replay ("could not decrypt encrypted_content")

question: Should maintainers accept redacted pre-fix production logs plus focused positive/negative predicate tests as sufficient proof for this xAI/Grok code-less encrypted-content retry fix?
rationale: The normal contributor proof gate asks for after-fix real behavior, but the PR discussion explains that the exact error depends on xAI rotating provider-side encrypted-content state and cannot be triggered faithfully by the client on demand.

options.title: Accept the proof exception
options.body: Treat the existing logs, source-level reproduction, passing CI, and narrow predicate tests as sufficient for this non-inducible provider-side failure mode.

options.title: Wait for organic after-fix proof
options.body: Keep the PR open until a future real xAI/Grok stale-content event produces redacted gateway logs showing the retry succeeds after this patch.

options.title: Require a different fix shape
options.body: Ask for a broader provider-error or circuit-breaker design instead of landing this narrow recovery predicate now.

recommendation.title: Accept the proof exception
recommendation.body: Treat the existing logs, source-level reproduction, passing CI, and narrow predicate tests as sufficient for this non-inducible provider-side failure mode.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the adjacent accepted retry mechanism and are the strongest available owner for deciding whether this proof matches that existing recovery contract.
